value.rationale: For an exogenously hidden uniform target, the theorem completely resolves relocation-design fairness and mean performance simultaneously across all finite transitive graphs; its exact heterogeneity penalty quantifies the cost of poor allocations. The Kemeny-versus-uniform-target distinction changes the mathematical design objective. The exact smallest-cycle size five for advantageous nonzero resetting, radical C5 optimum and large-cycle scaling make a nontrivial natural classification and reproducible benchmark.
